definitions.explanation: An official document recording an animal's ancestry, issued for purebred dogs, cats, horses and other animals.

examples.english: This cat has a pedigree certificate.

examples.japanese: {血統書付|けっとうしょつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。

{血統書付|けっとうしょつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{雑種|ざっしゅ}→雑種：32467_zasshu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧くらい⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: Pedigreed puppies are expensive, but mixed breeds are just as cute.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {血統書付|けっとうしょつ}き: pedigreed, with papers; also said jokingly of a person from a distinguished family

- {純血種|じゅんけつしゅ}: purebred
- ⟦{雑種|ざっしゅ}→雑種：32467_zasshu⟧: mixed breed
